purpose: Define how search/routing handles suicide and overdose queries without returning harmful detail or advice.
search_rule: Route grief, stigma, language, and postvention questions to protected records; do not answer method-seeking, scene-seeking, note-seeking, toxicology-speculation, or response-instruction queries with corpus detail.
fallback_posture: Show safety interstitial and route to qualified crisis, survivor, local authority, or professional resources only after public resource-routing review; current cube remains non-public.
